symbol_capture.coverage_note: Heuristic extraction of literal name:function, function Name, local named arrows, uppercase constant-like keys, and explicit object exports. Anonymous/computed methods may not be named.

dependency_capture: Every regex-identified direct t(numeric_id) within module text with occurrence offsets. Dynamic imports and factory calls computed at runtime not resolved.

confidence.CONFIRMED: syntax, source positions, imports, exports, formulas directly in source
confidence.INFERRED: feature-category assignment and some class role names
confidence.UNKNOWN: external game usage, server authority, browser-dependent execution

unresolved_findings: Need cross-asset matching of Phaser imports P/p, game bootstrap and scene definitions
Need application-specific network endpoints/protocols and authority checks
Need runtime configuration to know whether Arcade/Matter/WebGL/Canvas/plugins are active
Need runtime testing before asserting actual game behavior
A full parser-based AST pass would increase precision for anonymous/computed methods and complex minified constructs
